dialogue_or_narration.text_zh: 别碰我手机！说了买了就是买了，老是动手动脚的干嘛。

prompt_en: Chinese modern comic style, contemporary urban realism, soft cinematic lighting, naturalistic proportions. High-angle 60-degree extreme close-up looking down at a small white computer desk surface. Center top: a smartphone in a rose-pink silicone case lying flat on the desk with its screen brightly lit showing an e-commerce order details page in Chinese for a birthday gift delivery. Center: two hands in close confrontation — a female hand with fresh nude-pink gel manicure pressing down flat on the phone with all five fingers splayed, the fingertips going slightly white from the pressure — and a male hand with untrimmed fingernails reaching in from the lower-right of the frame, the index and middle fingers extended toward the phone but stopped just 2-3 centimeters short of the woman's fingers, the two sets of fingertips almost touching. The wood grain of the desk surface is visible in sharp detail. Cool blue-white light from the desk lamp above. Mood: the smallest unit of marital violence, the conflict reduced to fingertips and a phone, no faces, no words can soften this physical standoff. Text watermark 'P16-PN04' in the bottom-right corner placed where it does not obscure the central hands.
negative_prompt_en: anime proportions, full faces visible, smiling, decorative phone case design beyond the rose-pink silicone, daylight from a window, second character in frame, romantic soft lighting, dramatic shadows, hands already touching or grabbing each other (they must almost touch but not quite)
